An '''ar'gor''' was a [[Sword/Legends|bladed]] melee weapon used during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The weapons were sold for 175 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each by [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]].<ref name="Galladinium" /> [[Kassar Kosciusko]], a former [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]], owned an ar'gor blade.<ref name="Operatives" />
